recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. Any future section-anchor or ballot tooling improvement for extension pages should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack or IG Publisher/tooling rather than by restoring the retired core registry page.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive issue asked for section references for extensions on the 2022Sep FHIR-core extensibility registry so ballot comments could cite specific extensions.
initial_application: No core commit directly mentioned FHIR-39209. FHIR-I minutes recorded the tracker as reassigned to tooling, the Jira closure says it was handled as part of the new extensions IG, extension-pack history created the registry IG source in February 2023, and core history removed source/extensibility-registry.html in March 2023 as content moved to the extensions IG.
additional_context: Current core publish.ini comments out extensibility-registry.html and source/extensibility-registry.html is absent. Core history says all extensions moved to hl7.fhir.uv.extensions at http://hl7.org/fhir/extensions. The FHIR Extension Pack checkout defines packageId hl7.fhir.uv.extensions and includes the active extension registry and child extension-category pages.
reconciliation: No FHIR core source was changed. The old core registry is out of build scope, and the current source-of-truth for the requested extension registry presentation is the external FHIR Extension Pack repository.
